thread:
Noah Kaplan: Kicking off Avalon onboarding thread. Need to confirm stakeholders, GDPR data-handling constraints, SSO, and a compact 0-30 plan. Proposed Mon 5/3 11:00am PT for a 30m kickoff. Agenda: owners, access, success gates, blockers.

Tess Rivera: Mon 11 works. Quick Q: Avalon on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private? That changes our checklist.

Ethan Zhou (Avalon): Private VPC w/ strict GDPR controls. We'll start with 8k product docs + 3k chat logs (anonymized).

Riya Menon: I'll own enablement + evaluation. I'll put together a pre-kick form: SSO metadata (Okta), data retention preferences, and sampling guidance.

Noah Kaplan: Draft owner map:
- Avalon exec sponsor: Ethan Zhou
- Avalon infra: Priyanka (will confirm)
- Redwood CSM: Noah Kaplan
- Redwood Solutions: Riya Menon -> enablement/workshop
- Redwood Infra: Tess Rivera -> Private deploy & capacity

Noah Kaplan: Proposed success criteria (edit pls):
- Authenticated endpoint reachable from Avalon VPC (SAML)
- Initial ingest (11k docs) indexed and searchable within 48-72h
- Privacy check: no raw PII in results after automated redaction checks
- Pilot NPS >= 4/5 from 8 power-users week 2

Ethan Zhou (Avalon): Add: data retention policy honored (7-day cache TTL) and EU region hosting.

Tess Rivera: For capacity we'll reserve a small Dedicated pool day0-30 and enable burst to Hosted if spikes. Need sample QPS to finalize.

Riya Menon: I'll prep a 90-min enablement session for week2 and an eval pack (prompts + regression set). Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/playbooks/avalon-onboard-draft

Noah Kaplan: Blockers to track: GDPR legal review, Okta SAML metadata (Ethan), network allowlist (Priyanka), dataset anonymization check. Renewal signal = pilot usage + NPS; flag below-thresholds for exec review.

Ethan Zhou (Avalon): Will share Okta admin and a 2k anonymized sample by Fri EOD. Legal will start GDPR checklist this week.

scheduler-bot: Meeting created: "Avalon Onboarding Kickoff" Mon May 3 11:00am PT  invite sent. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/avalon-onboard-0503

Tess Rivera: Posting firewall/snippet to validate pre-kick:
```
# Avalon allowlist (example)
allow tcp 443 -> 10.33.0.0/16
allow tcp 8443 -> 10.33.0.9
```

Riya Menon: I'll add the pre-kick checklist and pilot timeline (0-30) here before EOD.

Noah Kaplan: Thanks team  I'll publish the owner timeline + go/no-go gating map later today.
